No human reviewed or tested anything, no hardware was attached, no --backend hardware or --allow-hardware was run, and no ROS graph, rosbridge connection, Gazebo process, PX4/MAVROS stack, mapping or navigation run is claimed.

RECON AND SCOPE: The pinned repository is a ROS 1 catkin application for an indoor quadcopter: Gazebo worlds and a hector model (quadcopter_gazebo/launch/quadcopter.launch:11-29), PX4/MAVROS launch files, teleoperation and take-off/land nodes, gmapping/cartographer, move_base, and the quadcopter_results node. The Results node subscribes to /ground_truth_to_tf/pose (geometry_msgs/PoseStamped), /move_base/status (actionlib_msgs/GoalStatusArray) and /results_saver (std_msgs/Empty) at quadcopter_results/src/quadcopter_results.py:50-76. This package is a configuration-only RosDriver over rosbridge; it declares no Python native class and neither imports nor launches the clone. The exposed surface is two explicit fresh-subscription observations: a PoseStamped sample on /ground_truth_to_tf/pose and a GoalStatusArray sample on /move_base/status. Each observation is an x-cap read action with an inline wire schema; the main resource has no automatic reads, so its snapshot is empty and a silent topic fails only the observation that asked for it. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised.

CARD HINTS AND CLASSES: The card hints name Results methods (get_delta_dist, get_df, set_avg_speed, set_elapsed_time, set_total_dist, reset_params). These are in-process Python methods, not ROS services, topics or actions; the Results node exposes only its three subscriber topics and computes the metrics in process. cap.device.configure.v1 is a write/patch class and the pinned nodes expose no writable ROS service or parameter endpoint. cap.sensing.read.v1 requires a sensor resource kind and a generic values object with sampled_at/sequence; it cannot carry a typed PoseStamped or GoalStatusArray. The two x-cap extension ids are used instead, and both are requested above.

CONTROL LIMITATION: The motion surface is deliberately not bound: /cmd_vel, /quadcopter_land, the PX4/MAVROS setpoint and service calls, and move_base goals. The Results constructor creates only subscribers and calls rospy.spin (quadcopter_results/src/quadcopter_results.py:73-79); the take-off/land node creates subscribers and a /cmd_vel publisher (quadcopter_takeoff_land/src/quadcopter_takeoff_land.py:31-38); the navigation documentation publishes /quadcopter_land at 5 Hz as std_msgs/Empty (docs/navigation.md:56). There is no acknowledged stop service or action, a zero-velocity publication is transmission-only, and the repository has no world pause, step or reset endpoint. A control profile would need a stop contract the pinned source does not provide; if the orchestrator requires the motion/control surface, this card should be treated as HELPER_MISSING rather than accepting this observation profile as full task control. NOT COVERED: the in-process distance/elapsed-time/average-speed calculations, the pandas dataframe and the CSV written to ~/catkin_ws/src/quadcopter_sim/quadcopter_results/src/Results.csv on /results_saver (quadcopter_results/src/quadcopter_results.py:239-249), the /results_saver save trigger, takeoff, landing, teleoperation, mapping, navigation, the move_base action protocol, PX4/MAVROS and Gazebo stepping. The CSV and the computed metrics are not a ROS topic or service and rosbridge cannot carry them.

SAFETY: mode simulated, device_kind world.sim, risk R1 because the card's risk_floor is R1 (the x-caps carry no catalogue class floor). Only topic observations are bound; there is no motion, actuation or effectful service. A stock e-stop is software-only and latches the extension reads, which have no catalogue-read exemption; no native stop, simulator pause, world step or reset is declared. This is not a hardware e-stop claim. No numeric input is declared, so there is no Limit and no site-limits.example.json is needed.

FAKE AND FIDELITY: fake.py is a ROS-free mhs.bridge.ros_transport.RecordingRosTransport contract stand-in, not a replay of captured traffic and not the upstream simulator. It answers the two subscriptions and runs no Gazebo physics, PX4 SITL, MAVROS, gmapping, cartographer, move_base, TF, ROS graph or wall-clock loop. It claims F0 with engine canned, determinism none, timestep_ms 0, realtime_factor 0, reset none and no snapshot/restore. All pose, orientation, stamp, goal-id and status values are placeholders; the fake returns one GoalStatus entry, while the live status_list length is not fixed by the clone. The pose and status samples do not establish a trajectory, sensor frame, navigation outcome or timing.

TESTS: test_driver.py keeps check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') and adds nine repository cases: the pose observation, the goal-status observation, the pinned endpoint/type pairs for both subscriptions, the absence of any actuation operation, a silent topic, an unrelated publication id, a failed subscription, malformed pose and status messages, and the software-only e-stop latch. No network, pip install or upstream execution was used; the clone remains unmodified at 01d02f6e2fad8060d6522b7bca01cb82aa038c2a and no bytecode is left in the package.
